column1: # Home paths: how every root validator compares a root with $HOME (Rust
# validate::is_valid_root, the shared bash valid_root, rclone-mount, Model.js).
# The home is normalised the same way everywhere before the comparison: runs
# of / collapsed to one, every "." component dropped, every trailing / dropped
# (".." is kept as written). A home that normalises to "/" (or "") is no home:
# the home rule is skipped. Roots here pass every other rule of roots.tsv.
